state.question: Name the tall sculptural landmark in this campus plaza.
state.answer: The image shows a tall, slender, pointed sculptural landmark in a campus plaza setting. The sculpture appears to be constructed from vertical metal elements, giving it a ribbed or striated texture. It stands on a tiered base with visible inscriptions. People are walking near the sculpture, suggesting it is a public art installation within a university or college campus.
